_comment: Vercel Hobby allows at most 2 cron jobs and once-a-day granularity, so only the two daily jobs live here. /api/push/reminders needs a ping every few minutes to be useful and is driven by an external pinger instead — see docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md. On Pro, add it here as { "path": "/api/push/reminders", "schedule": "*/5 * * * *" } and drop the external pinger.
